AI NEWS DAILY — 7 Nov 2026

TOP STORY
OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, a security model that finds exploitable vulnerabilities and drafts fixes, and graded it Critical on its own preparedness scale — the first mainstream model a vendor has rated that high. It reports 48.5% on ExploitGym, 81 previously unknown Firefox flaws and 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation exploits, at $20 per million input tokens, behind vetting and IP allowlisting.

5 KEY UPDATES
1. DeepMind says AI-guided cryptanalysis found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA, making signature forgery ~1,600x cheaper. It stresses modern 2048-bit RSA is unaffected.
2. METR: Anthropic's capability progress has roughly doubled, likely driven by internal AI use in R&D — with much of the evidence redacted.
3. Open weights in volume: Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Small (594B MoE, Apache 2.0 promised), Tencent Hunyuan Hy4 (770B with computer use), Baidu's untuned 280B ERNIE base, Ant Ling-3.2-flash, and Ricursive Ripple-65B under Apache 2.0 on one workstation.
4. Agents leave the chat box: Perplexity launched always-on Teammates at $200/month; Anthropic gave Claude read-only bank account access via Plaid.
5. The money is wobbling: Anthropic's $1.5 trillion IPO target meets investor resistance, and the Nasdaq fell 5.5% in a day on AI-regulation fears.

CONCEPT OF THE DAY — The Harness Is the Model
A banking-compliance study held the model fixed and changed only the scaffolding around it: compliance swung 11.5 points for one model, enough to move it from first to last. 26% of violations showed up only in tool traces, never in transcripts. What you deploy is not the model — it is the model plus its harness.

Full briefing: https://dilip457.github.io/ai-news-daily/
